binary-search.problem: Find the index of a target value in a sorted array.

quicksort.problem: Sort an array using divide-and-conquer partitioning.

mergesort.problem: Sort an array by recursively merging sorted halves.

bfs.problem: Traverse a graph level by level from a start node.

dijkstra.problem: Compute shortest paths from a source in a weighted graph.

prim.problem: Build a minimum spanning tree by growing from a start node.
